articles.summary: This holiday season, we invite you to give the gift of NaturAll by donating to Dignity Housing, a non-profit organization based in Philadelphia, PA. Dignity Housing provides quality, affordable housing to residents of our hometown, to help decrease our homeless population and serve some of our most vulnerable populations. Read on to find out why this partnership is so important to us!
